subject: Follow-up: Veridian Bio POC success criteria & trial plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianbio.com>, Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Veridian Bio POC success criteria & trial plan

Hi Alyssa / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment on the high-level goals. Per our discussion, I pulled together a concise POC plan so we can move quickly and make the exec review straightforward. High-level items below; I attached the full plan (Veridian_POC_Plan_v2.pdf).

POC objective:
- Validate Redwood inference for Veridian Bio's document ingestion + summarization pipeline on your 6-month clinical dataset.

Success criteria (agreed on call):
1) Average end-to-end latency <= 400ms for 1-2 concurrent analyst requests (90th percentile)
2) Summaries achieve >= 0.85 F1 against your internal evaluation set on key fields (study name, key findings, sample size)
3) No PII leakage incidents; KMS key integration tested and logs available
4) Cost estimate within the expected budget (see attached cost sheet)

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Data ingestion & sample set: Veridian (Alyssa, Daniel)
- Model selection & config: Redwood SE (Marcus)
- Integration + deployment to dedicated trial: Redwood (Marissa) + Veridian Eng (TBD)
- Quality evals & acceptance: Joint (Veridian product lead + Redwood solutions)

Timeline (proposed):
- Kickoff & sample delivery: Week of 5/25
- Trial build & smoke tests: 1 week
- 2-week evaluation window: 6/1-6/14
- Final readout + exec decision: target week of 6/15

Next steps:
- Marcus: confirm resource availability for the 5/25 kickoff and outline any infra needs
- Alyssa: confirm the sample delivery date and point-of-contact for engineering work
- I'll circulate the SOW draft and DocuSign link once we lock the timeline

Attachment: Veridian_POC_Plan_v2.pdf (full plan), Redwood_Cost_Estimate.xlsx (estimates)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we confirm dates.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@veridianbio.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Veridian Bio POC success criteria & trial plan

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications: 

- Sample delivery: we can provide the initial 200-document set by Wednesday 5/27; Pablo (our eng lead) will be the POC contact.
- Evaluation metric: 0.85 F1 is fine as a target; can you outline the exact eval script you plan to run so we can reproduce locally?
- Budget: the estimate looks in-range, but procurement needs a clear timeline to approve the commitment. Can we confirm the final readout week by Friday 5/22?

Also looping in procurement for visibility: procurement@veridianbio.com

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get started.

Best,
Alyssa
Director, Product 
Veridian Bio

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianbio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Veridian Bio POC success criteria & trial plan

Hi all — quick SE note. We can meet the latency target with a lightly quantized Llama-variant (8-bit q4/gguf) on a single DGX-style node for the 1-2 analyst load; I'll throw together a checklist for infra and sample size.

Questions for Veridian:
- Are the documents mostly plain text PDFs or scanned images with OCR? If scanned, what's % scanned vs born-digital?
- Any corpus-level rate limits or locked-down network zones we should know about?

I'll be available for the kickoff week and can own the model config + smoke tests.

Attachments: SE_checklist.md (inline in drive)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianbio.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Veridian POC - logistics and owners

Marcus / Elliot — following up on Marcus's note. Alyssa confirmed sample delivery 5/27 and Pablo will be the Veridian Eng contact (I added him to the drive link). Please see assignments below: 

- Kickoff owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole — schedule and customer coordination
- SE/Model owner: Marcus Lin — model selection, quantization profile, smoke tests
- Deployment owner: Elliot Price — runtime config, KV caching, monitoring hooks
- Procurement / legal contact: I will own SOW and DocuSign follow-through

I’ll draft the calendar invite for the 5/25 kickoff (30-45m) and include the agenda: sample handoff, infra checklist, acceptance criteria, timeline + exec readout slot.

Also: flag for sales leader — Alyssa asked whether we can accelerate the final readout week to the week of 6/8 if everything moves fast. If we get samples on 5/27 and complete smoke tests by 5/29, a 1-week evaluation would be tight but possible — we should be explicit in the readout invite about expected review materials.

Marissa

From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianbio.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Veridian POC - logistics and owners

Thanks — noted. I’ll prepare the runtime checklist and make sure monitoring/tracing endpoints are instrumented for the trial so Alyssa can see token-level latency and per-route breakdowns during the eval.

Two quick asks: 
1) If Veridian wants a private deployment, procurement will require a short network diagram + KMS attestation sample for SOC evidence; can legal/procurement share preferred templates?
2) For the accelerated readout (week of 6/8), we should pre-agree on a trimmed deliverables list (smoke tests + 100-sample qualitative review). Otherwise stick to 6/15.

I’ll sync with Marcus on infra sizing and post the checklist in the drive.

Elliot

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianbio.com>, Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@veridianbio.com>, procurement@veridianbio.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-24T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling final readout & exec decision window (Veridian POC)

Hi Alyssa / Daniel / procurement —

Following our kickoff and the plan above, we want to lock the final readout and exec decision in your calendar. Based on current timing (samples due 5/27, smoke tests 5/29, 2-week eval 6/1-6/14), our recommended readout window is the week of 6/15. If you prefer the accelerated option (week of 6/8), please confirm by EOD Friday 5/28 so we can prioritize resources.

Readout agenda (30-45m):
- High-level POC goals & architecture
- Quantitative results vs success criteria (latency, F1, cost)
- Key risks & mitigation (security/PII controls, infra stability)
- Recommendation: go/no-go and recommended next step (Dedicated capacity proposal + SOW)

Decision process:
- Veridian execs will provide a go/no-go decision during the readout; procurement will follow up for contract steps.
- If go: Redwood will issue the SOW + DocuSign envelope for signature (I will own issuance).
- If no-go: we'll document gaps and recommended follow-up experiments.

Action items before readout:
- Veridian: confirm accelerated vs standard readout (reply by 5/28) and confirm procurement POC reviewer
- Redwood: finalize SOW draft (attached) and post the evaluation report to the shared drive 24h before readout

Attachments: SOW_Draft_Veridian.docx, Redwood_Cost_Estimate.xlsx

Proposed tentative readout slots (please indicate availability):
- Tue 6/16 10:00-10:45 PT
- Wed 6/17 14:00-14:45 PT
- Thu 6/18 09:00-09:45 PT

I’ll follow up with a formal calendar invite once you confirm the slot. Thanks all — looking forward to the readout.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
